skill.summary: Family meal planning tool that provides weekly menu planning, nutrition analysis, shopping list generation, ingredient management, and recipe recommendations...

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of Home Food Planner.
- Provides weekly menu planning, ingredient management, shopping list generation, nutrition analysis, and recipe recommendations.
- Supports special diet planning and usage examples for different family needs.
- Includes ready-to-use meal plans and a recipe collection for quick reference.
